items.detail: USTR notice (91 FR 72610) extends all 178 current exclusions; the DATES section states the extension runs through 11:59 p.m. ET on January 9, 2027, and the annexes amend headings 9903.88.69 and 9903.88.70 to read 'January 9, 2027'.
items.scope_note: All 178 current Section 301 product exclusions in the technology-transfer investigation only: 164 under HTSUS heading 9903.88.69 and 14 solar manufacturing equipment exclusions under heading 9903.88.70; applies to goods entered for consumption on or after 12:01 a.m. ET Nov 10, 2026 and before 11:59 p.m. ET Jan 9, 2027; no new exclusion request window.

items.detail: USTR notice (91 FR 72608) further suspends the maritime Section 301 actions for two months, until January 10, 2027; the DATES section states coverage runs through 11:59 p.m. ET on January 9, 2027, so January 10 is the first day not covered.
items.scope_note: Suspension (not repeal) of the Section 301 maritime/logistics/shipbuilding actions only: maritime transport service fees under Annexes I, II, III and duties on ship-to-shore cranes and other cargo handling equipment under Annex V.A; during suspension no party accrues liability for those fees or duties; USTR will decide before Jan 10, 2027 whether to continue the suspension.
